item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Server 2025 support on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
item.description:
SQL Server 2025 is now in public preview on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. This lets users evaluate, test, and deploy SQL Server on Canonical’s latest long-term supported platform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Node 22 LTS ends on April 30, 2027
item.description:
Support for Node 22 LTS on Azure App Service ends April 30, 2027. Apps will keep running after that date, but security updates and customer support for Node 22 LTS will stop.

  • Source: Azure Updates
